title: hs code classification: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 26 min of staff time per product line (blended)

steps.task: Collect product lists and spec sheets from the client; chase missing material and use details
Read the spec sheet: what the product is, what it is made of, what it does
Search the nomenclature: section and chapter notes, candidate headings and subheadings
Apply the GRIs in order, check the explanatory notes, settle on a CN or TARIC code
Search EBTI, classification regulations and the firm's past rulings for comparable goods
Look up duty, preferential rates, trade remedies and restrictions in TARIC
Review and sign off the code and the rationale
Key the code into the client's product master and file the rationale

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 5.7 min of specialist time per product line (blended)

steps.task: Load product lists and spec sheets, OCR PDFs, drop lines already in the product master
Pull material, composition, function and presentation; draft questions for missing facts
Spot colour and size variants of products already classified and signed off
Retrieve headings, section and chapter notes, explanatory notes, BTIs and regulations
Apply GRI 1 to 6 in order; propose the code with cited notes and rejected alternatives
Test the proposal against BTIs, classification regulations and the firm's past rulings
Pull duty, preferential rates, trade remedies and restrictions for the code and origin
Sign off every new code; full review of low-confidence lines and conflicts
Write code, sources, nomenclature version, models and reviewer to the product master
